step5_question.question: Using Procter & Gamble's Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended June 30, 2026 (and the fiscal 2025 Form 10-K for balances as of June 30, 2024), compute P&G's cash conversion cycle for fiscal 2026 and fiscal 2025. Use averages of beginning- and end-of-year balances and a 365-day year: DIO = average inventories / cost of products sold x 365; DSO = average accounts receivable / net sales x 365; DPO = average accounts payable / cost of products sold x 365; CCC = DIO + DSO - DPO (computed from unrounded components). Report DIO, DSO, DPO and CCC for both years in days rounded to one decimal place, and state whether the CCC increased or decreased.
